# Test fixtures and helpers

This directory contains test fixtures and helper utilities.

## Fixtures

- `sample.ifc` - Small test IFC file for basic testing
- `invalid.ifc` - Invalid/corrupted file for error testing
- `expected_output.xml` - Expected XML output for comparison

## Helpers

- `test-server.js` - Helper to start test server
- `test-utils.js` - Common test utilities
